events.title: Swiss Market Ends Slightly Down
events.description:
Save for a very brief while a few minutes before the closing bell, the Swiss stock market stayed in negative territory on Monday. 

The market's loss was just marginal as the sharp slide in oil prices helped ease concerns about inflation.

events.title: European Markets Rise As Oil Falls On Iran Peace Hopes
events.description: Major European indices climbed Monday as oil prices dropped sharply on expectations that Iranian and Qatari diplomatic discussions could ease Middle East tensions. The pan-European Stoxx 600 gained 0.42%, while UK, German, and French markets advanced. Investors also digested October PMI data ahead of the Bank of England's monetary policy announcement.

events.title: TSX Up Over 1% As Oil's Slide Lifts Sentiment
events.description: The Canadian market is up firmly in positive territory around noon on Monday with stocks from various sectors moving up sharply amid easing concerns about inflation following a sharp drop in oil prices.

events.title: U.S. Construction Spending Unexpectedly Pulls Back Sharply In September
events.description: Construction spending in the U.S. unexpectedly pulled back sharply in the month of September, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Monday. The report said construction spending tumbled by 1.9 percent to an annual rate of $2.186 trillion in September after surging by 2.0 percent to a revised rate of $2.227 trillion in August.

events.title: U.S. Manufacturing Index Increases More Than Expected In October
events.description: The Institute for Supply Management released a report on Monday showing its reading on U.S. manufacturing activity increased by more than expected in the month of October. The ISM said its manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5 in October after edging down to 54.5 in September, with a reading above 50 indicating growth. Economists had expected the index to inch up to 54.6.

events.title: Bay Street Set For Positive Open As Oil Prices Plunge
events.description: Canadian equities poised for gains Monday as crude oil prices drop sharply on Iran-Qatar diplomatic discussions. Imperial Oil reports Q3 earnings of $5.11 per share versus $2.17 a year ago. Multiple companies scheduled to report quarterly results today.

events.title: Marriott Lifts FY26 Outlook After Higher Q3; Shares Rise
events.description: Marriott International, Inc., while reporting higher third-quarter profit, revenues and global RevPAR, on Monday issued outlook for its fourth quarter, and raised fiscal 2026 view citing expectations for continued healthy demand. In pre-market activity on Nasdaq, the shares were gaining around 3.18 percent.

events.title: FTSE 100 Edges Down 0.06% As Energy Stocks Weigh
events.description: U.K. stocks showed mixed performance Monday amid cautious trading ahead of the Bank of England's monetary policy announcement. Mining and real estate stocks gained while energy stocks fell as crude oil prices declined sharply on diplomatic hopes regarding Iran.

events.title: Dollar Rallied Last Week Amidst Rate Hike Bets
events.description: The U.S. Dollar firmed up during the week ended October 30 amidst hawkish monetary policy signals from the Fed, a rise in PCE-based inflation readings, solid U.S. economic growth update as well as persisting safe haven demand.

events.title: French Stocks Rise Despite Fitch Downgrade; Oil's Tumble Aids Sentiment
events.description: Oil prices fell sharply to $108.75 per barrel Monday as discussions between Iranian officials and Qatari mediators offered hope for resolving supply concerns. French stocks advanced with the CAC 40 gaining 0.36%, though Fitch downgraded the nation's credit outlook citing public finance sustainability risks.

events.title: DAX Gains 0.4% As Lower Oil Prices Boost Sentiment
events.description: German stocks climbed Monday as oil prices fell on diplomatic hopes between Iran and Qatar, though a 2% monthly drop in September retail sales limited gains. The DAX gained 0.4%. Fresenius rose 2.5% after signing a biosimilars agreement with WuXi Biologics.

events.title: Eurozone Manufacturing Sector Logs Robust Growth
events.description: The euro area manufacturing activity expanded at a solid pace in October despite slowdown in factory order growth and intensifying supply-chain pressures, final purchasing managers' survey data from S&P Global showed Monday. The final manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index fell to 52.7 in October from 52.9 in the previous month, which was the highest score since May 2022.

events.title: Indian Shares Rise For Third Day, Reliance And Tata Steel Lead Rally
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Monday, extending gains for a third consecutive session as heavyweight Reliance posted stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings and oil prices slumped amid diplomatic efforts to end the war in Iran.
